_note: Colour literals in app/ that are deliberately NOT Spectrum tokens. check-conformance.mjs reads this file; anything here is content or platform chrome, never app UI. `allow` is scoped by file — a literal cleared for demo artwork in app/data.js is NOT cleared for chrome elsewhere (the flat, unscoped map this replaced could not tell those apart). Use "*" only for something genuinely global. Adding an entry is a design decision — say why.

deviations.what: S2 workflow 集之外还有一族自绘的描边图标
deviations.why: 第 41 轮把原来 70 枚内联手绘全换掉：S2 workflow 里有的语义一律逐字取自 _ds/adobe-spectrum-2/icons/*.svg（填充族，36 枚），另有 5 枚是拿同族原件切/镜像出来的（minus 取 Add 的横杠、upload 镜像 Download 的箭头、zoomin/zoomout 把 Add 的杠收进 Search 的镜内、drag 复制 More 的圆点）。剩下 38 枚是 S2 确实没有的语义（字幕/翻译/波形/剪刀/倍速/音量/翻转/层序…），统一画在同一张 20×20 网格、同一条 1.5 视觉笔宽、同一块 2–18 活字区上（每枚画的是什么写在 app/icons.jsx 每条末尾）。这一族走 stroke，与填充族视觉重量一致。三张出货表面（apps/mac、apps/baocut、skills/baocut/templates/studio）本来就是同一种「S2 原件 + 补充描边族」的构造，本轮是原型追平。
deviations.upstream: _ds/adobe-spectrum-2/icons（49 枚原件，随本轮入库）+ apps/baocut/assets/icons

deviations.what: Source Sans 3 leads the font stack instead of Adobe Clean
deviations.why: Adobe Clean is not redistributable and the artboards are pixel-tuned; leading with the open Source face keeps the measure identical on every machine. Clean still follows in the stack for licensed hosts.
It draws the macOS window itself, not an S2 surface; the OS radius is not on Spectrum's scale. Scoped to app/shell.jsx.

deviations.what: Settings › Local / Cloud models: the per-model and per-provider identity marks are oklch() literals, not Spectrum tokens
deviations.why: They are generated identity swatches, not UI surfaces — one hue per model family and per provider, all sharing the same lightness and chroma (0.5–0.55 L, 0.09–0.13 C) so a row of them reads as one set. Spectrum has no token axis for 'nine distinguishable vendor marks', and the Mac app's own settings window mints them the same way (vk-provider-mark). check-conformance.mjs only reads hex literals, so this entry exists to record the decision, not to silence a finding.
deviations.upstream: designs/baocut-mac/app/settings.jsx — vk-provider-mark（该原型已于 2026-09-02 归档，基线 53fcf7f9；此处仅记录色值来源，不是可访问路径）

deviations.what: The artboard-era 'desktop backdrop' literal (#5A5D63) is gone
deviations.why: The artboards sat a fake app window on a painted desktop so the screenshot read as macOS. The React carrier fills the viewport, so there is no backdrop to paint and the literal has no owner. Removed rather than re-scoped.

deviations.what: 元素动画的预览不走 150ms 的 S2 控件曲线（第 122 轮起不再是 CSS：`@keyframes apv*` 那 22 段已删）
deviations.why: 预览演的是元素在画布上怎么动（In/Out/Loop 各自的时长与缓动），是内容动效不是表面状态过渡；按 150ms 播会看不出淡入和落入的区别。第 122 轮起它由 `BC_TA` 按播放头逐帧求值、用真实播放器循环播放（editor-preview.jsx），CSS 里只剩一个承载 transform 的 `.anfr`。控件本身的 hover/press 过渡照旧走 S2 曲线。
